== Song Of The Elves ==

{{Checklist|title=Section 23|
* Go to Varrock Museum with [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Dagon%27hai_history Dragon'hai History Book]
** Collect lamp from [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Historian_Minas Historian Minas]
** Speak with [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Orlando_Smith Orlando Smith] for XP rewards (153 Kudos req)
* Get Slayer to 50
* Complete Quests
** [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Darkness_of_Hallowvale Darkness of Hallowvale]
** [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/A_Taste_of_Hope A Taste of Hope]
** [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/King%27s_Ransom King's Ransom]
** [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Knight_Waves Knight Waves Training Grounds]
** [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Dream_Mentor Dream Mentor] w/ Ibans
** A [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/A_Kingdom_DividedKingdom Divided]
** Assumed 57 Herblore, if you aren't, make potions/[https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Mastering_Mixology Mixology]
** [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Grim_Tales Grim Tales]
** [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Fairytale_II_-_Cure_a_Queen Fairytale Part 2]
** [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Rum_Deal Rum Deal]
** [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Cabin_Fever Cabin Fever]
** [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/The_Great_Brain_Robbery Great Brain Robbery]
** [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Sins_of_the_Father Sins of the Father]
** [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/While_Guthix_Sleeps While Guthix Sleeps]
** [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Mage_Arena_I Mage Arena 1]
** [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Mage_Arena_II Mage Arena 2]
* Get 70 Construction with [https://osrsportal.com/mahogany-homes Mahogany Homes]
** 2300 Teak Logs into planks in [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Auburnvale Auburnvale] and 100 Steel bars
** After you're done, put [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Managing_Miscellania Miscellania] onto Mahoganies
* It's assumed you're 70 Hunter here
** If you aren't, catch [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Chinchompa_(Hunter) Grey] then [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Red_chinchompa Red Chins] until 70
* Complete all Diaries possible
* Get 70 Herblore if you aren't already via [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Mastering_Mixology Mixology]
** Optionally you can attempt to complete [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/The_Blood_Moon_Rises The Blood Moon Rises]
* Get a Runite Bar by sacrificing Rune Platelegs to the [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Nest_(nice) nest in Aldarin]
* Complete [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Song_of_the_Elves Song of The Elves] and all pre-reqs
{{Youtube|2ihnLkyRSpI}}
* Passive - When you're 85 Thieving, pickpocket [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Elf_(Thieving) Elves] for Enhanced Crystal Teleport Seed
* New Herb/Tree Run! Go through and update your setup with new available patches and teleports
** Continue running until 80 farming, then add in Hard Farming Contracts
** You can boost +3 farming easily with [[Garden Pie]]s
}}
